cells.announcement: November 18, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement – Customers on Serv-U 15.5.1 should begin transitioning to the latest version of Serv-U.
cells.eoe: February 18, 2026: End-of-Engineering (EoE) – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for Serv-U 15.5.1 will no longer be actively supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: November 18, 2026: End-of-Life (EoL) – SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for Serv-U 15.5.1.
